text: Hamare mohalle ki main sadak par bade gadde hain, bike se roz log gir rahe hain
Pani ki supply 4 din se band hai, tanker bhi nahi aa raha
Primary health centre mein doctor hafte mein sirf 2 din aate hain
Street lights kharab hain, raat ko chori ka darr rehta hai
School ki chhat se barish mein paani tapakta hai, bachche bheeg jate hain
Naali ka gandaa paani sadak par beh raha hai, machhar aur bimari phail rahi hai
Kooda 10 din se uthaya nahi gaya, badbu se rehna mushkil hai
Gaon mein bijli din mein sirf 5 ghante aati hai, kisan pump nahi chala paate
Bus stop par shed nahi hai, garmi aur barish mein bahut takleef hoti hai
Suggestion: gaon mein ek library aur computer centre khola jaye yuvaon ke liye
Hospital mein dawaiyan khatam hain, mareezon ko bahar se kharidni padti hai
Nadi kinare ka pul toot gaya hai, bachche school nahi ja paa rahe
Bijli ka taar neeche latak raha hai, kabhi bhi haadsa ho sakta hai
Suggestion: sadak kinare ped lagaye jayen aur park banaya jaye
Hand pump kharab hai, poore tole mein sirf ek hi chalu hai
